info.title: Pacta on-chain pre-execution checks
info.description: Pacta by Fractal Neurons: read-only, block-pinned EVM control-plane checks for agents (Ethereum, Base), plus one opt-in write route (POST /v1/requests: coverage / feature requests). Pricing mode: free_launch (free, no key).

get.summary: One-call pre-execution safety check of a contract before an agent interacts with it
get.description: One-call pre-execution safety check of a contract before an agent interacts with it: verdict (immutable / timelock / zero-delay timelock / multisig / EOA admin / unclassified / undeployed), 0-100 risk score, proxy + implementation, controller kind, zero-delay upgradeability and pause / blacklist / upgrade capabilities, pinned to a block.

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: EVM chain

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: 0x-prefixed 20-byte address (EIP-55 checksum enforced when mixed-case)

parameters.name: block
parameters.description: Block to pin: "latest" (default), a decimal block number or 0x-hex

parameters.name: caller_agent
parameters.description: Identifier of the calling AI agent, IDE, or framework (e.g. 'claude-code', 'cursor', 'windsurf', 'coinbase-agentkit', 'elizaos', 'langchain', 'chatgpt', 'gemini', 'custom-agent'). Optional attribution (omitted = 'unspecified'). Lowercase slug only; never include personal names, emails, or secrets. Optional over REST (required on the free MCP tier).

parameters.name: requester_role
parameters.description: Optional: high-level role category of the requester or system running this check (closed enum; no personal data). Optional over REST (required on the free MCP tier).

parameters.name: caller_purpose
parameters.description: Optional: operational workflow context for this pre-execution check (closed enum). Optional over REST (required on the free MCP tier).

source.description: live_rpc: read at pinnedBlock. (An RPC outage on an indexed target returns schema pacta.preflight_catalog_fallback.v1 with source pinned_catalog_fallback instead of a 502.)

catalogMatch.description: Present when (chain, address) is an indexed protocol contract, controller, surface or related contract: the verified, block-pinned Pacta record (slug, url, classification, Base EAS UIDs, pinnedBlock, whatDiffers).

activeGovernanceDiscussions.description: Optional: present only when the address is indexed in the Pacta forum digest (read-only Discourse summary); newest lastPostedAt first

402.description: x402 payment required (only when pricingMode is x402_paid)

get.summary: Free protocol / token lookup (in memory, no RPC; free in every pricing mode)
get.description: Resolve a protocol or token name, symbol, slug or 0x address to Pacta's verified record: canonical slug and URL, checksummed primary contract and controller, classification with its evidence basis (eas_attested vs rpc_observed, documentationComparison not_assessed), and preflightArgs {chain, address} ready for /v1/check/preflight. Unknown parameters are rejected (400 invalid_input).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Name, token symbol, slug or 0x address (<= 80 chars; empty or * lists the catalog). Alias: query.

parameters.name: caller_agent
parameters.description: Identifier of the calling AI agent, IDE, or framework (e.g. 'claude-code', 'cursor', 'windsurf', 'coinbase-agentkit', 'elizaos', 'langchain', 'chatgpt', 'gemini', 'custom-agent'). Optional attribution (omitted = 'unspecified'). Lowercase slug only; never include personal names, emails, or secrets. Optional.

parameters.name: requester_role
parameters.description: Optional: high-level role category of the requester or system running this check (closed enum; no personal data). Optional.

parameters.name: caller_purpose
parameters.description: Optional: operational workflow context for this pre-execution check (closed enum). Optional.

citationFooter.description: Present when a protocol matched: the first protocol result's 2-line text (record page with its Base Mainnet EAS UID, or 'RPC-observed baseline; Base Mainnet EAS: not_attested'; then the issuer paths: $0 doc-update queue, $500 Rapid Single-Gap Re-Verification pre-filled for the protocol, $2,500–$5,000 Full Dossier; payment never alters a classification). Every protocol result carries its own citationFooter; MCP also returns it as a second text content block.

400.description: invalid_input (overlong query, bad chain / kind / limit, unknown parameter)

get.summary: Control-plane status badge (SVG) of a published protocol; also HEAD
get.description: Three tiers: Aligned · Base EAS (every record an EAS-attested aligned baseline), Parameter Delta (EAS-attested, documentation differs), RPC-Observed (RPC-pinned only; documentation not assessed). 5-minute cache, CORS *.

get.summary: Pacta findings ready to post on X (pacta.x_feed.v1); also HEAD
get.description: One item per published protocol (adverse_delta, protective_delta, aligned_baseline, rpc_observed) plus active radar timelock operations (radar_timelock), in posting priority order. mainPostText (<= 270 chars) has no links or bare domains; replyPostText carries the receipt page and the Base EAS attestation. feedId is stable. Static data, free, 5-minute cache, CORS *.

schema.description: Comma list of: adverse_delta, protective_delta, radar_timelock, aligned_baseline, rpc_observed

400.description: invalid_input (unknown kind, bad slug or limit, unknown or repeated parameter)

post.summary: Opt-in coverage / feature request (free in every pricing mode; 5 per hour per caller)
post.description: Queue a coverage or feature request (same arguments as the pacta_submit_request MCP tool). An identical request_type + target_subject upvotes the existing request and returns the same request_id. Never opens a GitHub issue and never charges. contact_handle is optional, only with the user's explicit consent, and is stored privately (never returned by any route).

caller_agent.description: Identifier of the calling AI agent, IDE, or framework (e.g. 'claude-code', 'cursor', 'windsurf', 'coinbase-agentkit', 'elizaos', 'langchain', 'chatgpt', 'gemini', 'custom-agent'). Optional attribution (omitted = 'unspecified'). Lowercase slug only; never include personal names, emails, or secrets.

requester_role.description: Optional: high-level role category of the requester or system running this check (closed enum; no personal data).

caller_purpose.description: Optional: operational workflow context for this pre-execution check (closed enum).

request_type.description: What is missing: a protocol, a chain, a check surface, a doc/data discrepancy, or an MCP/API feature.

target_subject.description: Protocol / token slug, chain name, or chain:0xAddress the request is about (e.g. 'pendle-v2', 'arbitrum', 'base:0x...').

requested_capability.description: One sentence: the specific data, check or feature needed. No secrets, keys or personal data.

urgency_track.description: community_queue_free (default, free), active_due_diligence, issuer_24h_clearance_5k (paid issuer clearance), api_high_volume_sla.

forum_proposal_url.description: Optional https:// link to the governance forum proposal this request concerns.

contact_handle.description: Optional work email, Telegram @handle, or GitHub handle ONLY if the human user explicitly asks for follow-up or an invoice. NEVER guess or populate without explicit user consent; never pass keys or secrets.

400.description: invalid_request: missing / invalid field, secret, key, HTML, personal data or placeholder contact

429.description: More than 5 requests per hour from this caller (Retry-After)

source.description: live_rpc: read at pinnedBlock. (An RPC outage on an indexed target returns schema pacta.preflight_catalog_fallback.v1 with source pinned_catalog_fallback instead of a 502.)

catalogMatch.description: Present when (chain, address) is an indexed protocol contract, controller, surface or related contract: the verified, block-pinned Pacta record (slug, url, classification, Base EAS UIDs, pinnedBlock, whatDiffers).

activeGovernanceDiscussions.description: Optional: present only when the address is indexed in the Pacta forum digest (read-only Discourse summary); newest lastPostedAt first

get.summary: Live control-plane scan of a fixed public contract
30-day aggregate of observed client metadata (KV-backed when bound); not verified humans, not revenue

post.summary: Site analytics beacon (navigator.sendBeacon, text/plain JSON, <= 2048 bytes)

400.description: bad_beacon: unknown key, bad value, bad content type or over 2048 bytes

429.description: More than 60 beacons per minute from this caller

get.summary: Service status, pricing mode and prices

scope.const: Observed client metadata (User-Agent families, MCP clientInfo, beacon events). Not verified humans, not revenue.

byCallerAgent.description: /mcp tools/call only (never REST): self-reported caller_agent slugs of calls that passed the attribution gate

toolsCallOk.description: /mcp tools/call that passed the caller-attribution gate and were dispatched

toolsCallAttrRejected.description: /mcp tools/call refused with JSON-RPC -32602 caller_attribution_required (a non-blank invalid caller field)

toolsCallUnattributed.description: free-tier /mcp tools/call dispatched with omitted / blank caller fields (recorded as caller_agent 'unspecified')

toolsList.description: tools/list JSON-RPC requests (registry crawlers and health probes included; not unique users)

callerAttribution.description: Cloudflare edge country / continent (cf.country, cf.continent) + self-reported MCP caller slug / closed enums; no IP or PII stored

unindexedIntentSignals.description: Dark-funnel intent radar: unmatched lookups and pre-flights of unindexed addresses; aggregate counts, no IP / header / JWT / PII

submittedRequests.description: Opt-in demand queue (pacta_submit_request / POST /v1/requests): public fields only, never a contact handle

r.description: Referrer host (lowercase host only), "self", or empty/absent for direct
